raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Senior Associate - Fund Accounting
State Street Corporation | Pune
Dec 2021 - Present
Managed end-to-end fund accounting activities for 500+ mutual funds and investment portfolios, supporting daily NAV
calculations with 99.9% accuracy.
Executed investment accounting activities including purchases, sales, income accruals, expense accruals, subscriptions,
redemptions, and distributions.
Performed daily cash, position, and securities reconciliations with custodians, brokers, and accounting systems.
Validated portfolio pricing, market values, and security-level transactions before NAV release.
Processed fixed income securities activities including coupon accruals, interest payments, maturities, amortization, and
principal repayments.
Investigated and resolved reconciliation breaks, accounting exceptions, and NAV discrepancies within SLA timelines.
Supported corporate action events including dividends, stock splits, mergers, tender offers, and mandatory
reorganizations.
Coordinated with custody, pricing, middle-office, and client service teams to resolve operational issues and improve

service delivery.
Managed end-to-end Trade Life Cycle activities, including trade capture, validation, processing, settlement monitoring,
reconciliation and exception resolution. Performed trade validation and processing for investment transactions, ensuring accurate booking and timely settlement.
Maintained compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, client mandates, and regulatory requirements.
Performed daily cash, position and securities reconciliation between custodians, brokers and internal accounting systems
using reconciliation workflows and exception-management processes.

Investigated and resolved cash, position, trade and NAV breaks, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating with
relevant teams for timely closure.
Monitored reconciliation exceptions and ensured resolution within defined SLA and NAV reporting timelines.
Validated trade and portfolio data across accounting and custody records to identify discrepancies in quantity, price,
market value and transaction activity.
• Supported reconciliation controls to ensure accurate investment positions and accounting records prior to NAV release.
• Supported Investment Banking Operations across fund accounting and investment operations, covering securities
processing, investment transactions, reconciliation and NAV activities.
Processed and validated investment transactions including purchases, sales, subscriptions, redemptions and distributions
as part of daily fund operations.
Supported the trade lifecycle from transaction processing and validation through reconciliation, exception resolution and
settlement-related activities.
Coordinated with custody, middle-office, pricing and client service teams to resolve investment-operation exceptions and
ensure timely delivery.
Worked across equity, fixed income securities and corporate action transactions, supporting accurate accounting and
portfolio valuation.
Trade Lifecycle Management: Supported trade processing and validation, post-trade reconciliation, settlement monitoring,
exception investigation and resolution across investment transactions.

Savitribai Phule Pune University, Pune Certifications and Training • Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional (Imarticus Learning)
